params.caption: IELTS Speaking'ning birinchi qismida imtihonchi oddiy savol beradi: Do you like reading? Ko'pchilik esa Yes, I do deydi-yu, jim bo'lib qoladi. Javob to'g'ri, lekin ravonlik baholanadigan joyda bunday qisqa javob ball bermaydi. Yaxshiroq yo'li oddiy: javob, sabab va kichik misol. Masalan, Yes, I do, mainly because it helps me relax after classes. Right now I'm reading a short detective novel. Ya'ni: ha, asosan darsdan keyin dam olishimga yordam beradi, hozir qisqa detektiv roman o'qiyapman. Javobingiz "yo'q" bo'lsa ham shu usul ishlaydi: Not really, to be honest. I prefer podcasts, because I can listen to them on the bus. Aniq bilmasangiz, It depends deb boshlab, ikki holatni aytib bering. Uyda sinab ko'ring: 5 ta oddiy savolga telefonda 20-30 soniyalik javob yozib oling. 2-3 gapdan oshirmang, birinchi qismda uzun nutq kerak emas 🙂 📌 https://registan.edutizim.uz/order/entry/?survey=s33 📞 +998935512700 📱 Follow us on social media: 📱Telegram 📱Instagram 📱Location
